name: Bind completeAndAck/failTerminalAndAck/failRetryableAndAck/deadLetterAndAck to PGlite lifecycle writes
description: Replace every TODO/simulated durable write in work-queue.ts with real Drizzle/PGlite lifecycle writes. completeAndAck must write terminal durable state to WorkItemTable and WorkAttemptTable before XACK. failRetryableAndAck must write retry-scheduled durable state before requeue. deadLetterAndAck must write DeadLetterTable record before terminal XACK. This is the authority-critical binding that closes the kernel correctness gap.
dependsOn: Define PGlite Drizzle schema for diagnostic packets and dharma ledger
